title: The same run with the ε-closure folded in
notes: With ε-closure set to fold it into each symbol, one step reads the symbol and follows the ε-moves after it. The sets are the same as in the a|b example; there are just fewer steps. The pseudocode becomes S = E(move(S, c)).
ops: start q0; accept q5; q0 eps -> q1; q0 eps -> q3; q1 a -> q2; q3 b -> q4; q2 eps -> q5; q4 eps -> q5
